title: Physics Mock Test №8
subtitle: 45 tasks • 55 scored items • 3 hours • with formula sheet and calculator

cards.title: Quantum and nuclear physics
formulas: Conservation laws for A and Z

questions.text: A car's speed is 10 m/s. What distance (km) does it travel in 4 h?
If the power developed on a body of mass m increases linearly according to N = 2αt, what will be the instantaneous speed of the body?
A hare runs south at a speed of 3.9 m/s. To an eagle flying above it, the hare appears to move east at 5.2 m/s. What is the speed of the eagle relative to the ground (m/s)?
By what factor does the linear speed of an artificial satellite change if its orbital period increases 8 times?
The mass of a log is 1800 kg. What force (kN) is needed to lift one of its ends? g = 10 m/s².
A 6 kg body initially at rest moves with acceleration under a constant force of 3 N. Calculate the work (kJ) done by the force in 3 minutes.
A body is thrown vertically upward from the Earth's surface. By what factor is the body's speed at a height equal to 8/9 of the maximum height of rise smaller than its initial speed?
A simple pendulum makes 2 oscillations in 3 s. Find the length of the pendulum's string (cm). g = 10 m/s², π = 3.14
A load of mass 80 g hangs on a string that is being wound onto a pulley. When the pulley makes five revolutions, three meters of string are wound. What is the diameter of the pulley (cm)? π = 3.
What is the mass of 35 mol of CO₂ (g)?
Calculate the internal energy of 12 mol of a monatomic gas at a temperature of 27 °C (J). R = 8.31 J/(mol·K).

The relative humidity in a room of volume 30 m³ is 60%. If the room temperature is 23 °C, determine the mass of water vapor in the room (g). Saturated vapor density ρₜ (g/m³): 23 °C — 20.6; 24 °C — 21.8; 25 °C — 23.0.
A cylindrical steel column whose base touching the ground has an area of 75 cm² is 2.5 m high. What pressure (kPa) does this column exert on the ground? g = 10 N/kg, ρ = 7800 kg/m³.
A monatomic ideal gas is given 100 J of heat isobarically. How much work (J) does the gas do in this case?
Calculate the heat capacity of 9 mol of helium in a closed vessel (J/K).

A charged particle of mass 3m approaches from far away with initial kinetic energy E a charged particle of mass 2m that is initially at rest, and interacts with it. What is the smallest kinetic energy of the system during the interaction?
One capacitor has capacitance C and energy W, and the other has 2C and 3W. If the capacitors are connected with like poles together, how much heat is released in the process?
If a current source delivers a power of 230 W to the external circuit at a current of 10 A, and 337.5 W at a current of 15 A, determine its emf (V).
The charge of the first plate of a parallel-plate capacitor connected to a DC source is 6 nC. What is the charge of the second plate (nC)?
The electric field strength in a conductor is 2 V/m and the volumetric density of Joule heat released per unit time is 4 μW/m³. What is the current density in the conductor (μA/m²)?

In a bath containing a nickel salt solution the current changes according to i = 0.02t (A). Determine how much nickel (mg) is deposited in 240 s. The electrochemical equivalent of nickel is 3·10⁻⁷ kg/C.
There are two coils on a table: the first is connected to a galvanometer, the second is open. If a permanent magnet is inserted into each of them, in which case is electrical work done?
options: in both, but more in the second
in both, but more in the first

questions.text: After what time does the electric field in an oscillating circuit decrease from its maximum value to zero?
The Dulong–Petit law gives the molar heat capacity of solids, equal to 3R. According to this law, what is the specific heat capacity of vanadium (μ = 51 g/mol) (J/(kg·K))? R = 8.31 J/(mol·K).
What is the period of change of the magnetic field energy (ms) in an oscillating circuit with a 120 μF capacitor and a 30 H inductor? π = 3.
An electromagnetic wave with a wavelength of 480 nm is incident normally on a transparent film. The film thickness is 40 μm and its refractive index is 1.6. How many wavelengths fit inside the film?
At what distance is the focus of a concave spherical mirror of radius R located?
The distance between an object and its real image magnified 3 times is 80 cm. Find the focal length of the lens (cm).
A particle with a rest energy of 2.8 TJ moves at a speed of 0.6c. What is its momentum (kg·km/s)? c is the speed of light in vacuum.
There are two photons, and the period of the second is 2 times longer. If the speed of the first photon is c, what is the speed of the second?
The elementary particle neutral pion (π⁰) decays into two γ-quanta. If the rest mass of this particle is equal to 264 electron masses, find the frequency of the γ-radiation (Hz). h = 4.1·10⁻¹⁵ eV·s.

When the frequency of light incident on a metal was doubled, the stopping voltage for the photoelectrons tripled. The initial frequency of the incident light is 1.2·10¹⁵ Hz. Find the wavelength (nm) corresponding to the threshold (red limit) of this metal.
Determine the acceleration of the body of mass m₂ (m/s²).

questions.text: When a material point is displaced 4 cm from its equilibrium position its speed is 6 cm/s, and when displaced 3 cm its speed is 8 cm/s.

parts.text: Find the angular (cyclic) frequency of the material point.
Find the amplitude of the oscillations.

questions.text: When 400 mol of gas is heated isobarically by 500 K, it receives 5.82 MJ of heat.

parts.text: How much work did the gas do?
By how much did its internal energy increase?

questions.text: An Earth satellite moves in a circular orbit at a height of 1700 km above the Earth's surface. The radius of the Earth is 6400 km. υ₁ = 8 km/s.

parts.text: Find the orbital speed of the satellite.
Find the orbital period.

questions.text: Forces of 10 kN each are applied to the ends of a beam 5 m long with a cross-sectional area of 100 cm², and it is compressed by 1 cm.

parts.text: Find the mechanical stress.
Calculate the elastic modulus.

questions.text: A soap film on a wire frame with a movable crossbar 5 cm long is stretched by 10 cm. The surface tension coefficient of the soap solution is σ = 40 mN/m.

parts.text: What is the magnitude of the stretching force?
Calculate the work done.

questions.text: When the current through a coil of inductance 0.5 H is increased 2 times, the energy of the magnetic field increases by 3 J.

parts.text: Find the initial value of the current.
Find the initial value of the magnetic field energy.

questions.text: The inductive reactance of a coil is 500 Ω, the rms voltage of the mains to which it is connected is 100 V, and the frequency of the current is 10³ Hz.

parts.text: Determine the inductance of the coil.
Determine the amplitude of the current in the circuit.

questions.text: When an electron and a positron, each with kinetic energy 0.24 MeV, meet, they turn into two identical photons. mₑ = mₚ = 9.1·10⁻³¹ kg.

parts.text: Calculate the energy of each photon.
Find the wavelength of the photon.

questions.text: When an electron in a hydrogen atom moves from the first orbit to another, its kinetic energy increases 9 times.

parts.text: How did the orbital radius of the electron change?
How did the orbital period of the electron change?

questions.text: An α-particle emitted from a radium nucleus with a speed of 15 Mm/s travelled 3.3 cm in air and stopped. The mass of the α-particle is m = 6.64·10⁻²⁷ kg.

parts.text: Find the kinetic energy of the particle.
Find the braking time.
